Health, attack and drops below are read from the built behavior pack. Bosses have a boss bar and a second phase below half health; every boss gives **stars** (rank) and magic XP to everyone who fought it (the killer gets the most).

## Who fights whom

| Side | Members | Hunts |
|---|---|---|
| Clover Kingdom | Magic Knights, Ancient Constructs, the Travelling Merchant | all monsters (players only after being attacked) |
| Devil Host | Devils, the Archdevil, Dark Disciples, Imps, Devil Gates | players, Magic Knights, the Tidewatch |
| Sea Raiders | Sea Raiders, Raider Captains, Phantom Raiders, the Phantom Galleon | players, Magic Knights, the Tidewatch |
| Tidewatch Navy | Sentinels, Commodores | players with a bounty, pirates, devils, Dark Disciples |

Members of a side never hurt each other with magic. In War Table battles the armies only fight each other (and anyone who attacks them).

## Structures

* **Pirate outposts** - islands with palms, a tent, a dock, a campfire, a loot chest and a Bounty Board; appear out of sight while you sail over deep water.
* **Sunken wrecks** - two treasure chests (fruits, doubloons, maps) guarded by the Drowned.
* **Ancient dungeons** - form underground near explorers: a ruined entrance, a stairway, a corridor of **flame traps**, a pillared hall with a working Grimoire Altar, a treasure vault (ancient pages, squad robes, mana crystals, diamonds, treasure maps) and the Dungeon Guardian.
